title: Strategic Account Director, Developer Platform
description: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Available Locations: Austin, SF, Seattle, and NY About the Team Developer GTM is changing how Cloudflare wins and grows the next generation of builders, at a time when AI and agents are reshaping the application stack. We turn developer activity into lasting commercial outcomes. That means shaping usage into clear proposals, aligning pricing and packaging, giving the field repeatable motions, and feeding real-world signals back into Product. We work closely with Sales, Product, Finance, Legal, RevOps, and Marketing. About the Role Frontier labs hire former CTOs as senior Members of Technical Staff: high-impact individual contributors tasked with solving the hardest problems without the overhead of team management. This role applies that model to go-to-market. We are seeking former sales leaders and founders to own Cloudflare's Developer Platform growth inside a select portfolio of the most important technology companies in the world. As a Strategic Account Director, you will own the long-term Developer Platform strategy and consumption growth for one to three of Cloudflare's top 10 accounts including frontier AI labs and the most innovative software companies. Over time, the largest of these accounts will move to a dedicated 1:1 model. You'll partner with the account team to guide strategic decisions, lead engagement with key executives, and bring developer fluency married to deep business acumen. You'll collaborate as a peer with Cloudflare's sales leadership and work closely with Solutions Architects, Forward-Deployed Engineers, and Product. You are fluent in both developer workloads and commercial mechanics. You can set a multi-year account strategy in the morning and work through a live deal in the afternoon. What You Will Do Architect the account strategy. Build and execute a multi-year Developer Platform plan for each account: defining priority workloads, how adoption grows, competitive position, and the commercial path to get there. Accelerate the customer journey (drive activation → expansion → commercial structure): Use usage telemetry to find next-best actions, expansion paths, and risks. Remove technical, commercial, and organizational blockers so real workloads land and scale. Structure strategic deals. Work with the account executive, Deal Desk, Pricing, Finance, and Legal to design commit structures and consumption-based agreements that match how the customer actually builds. Compete credibly against hyperscalers and other platforms. Lead executive engagement. Build trusted relationships with CTOs and heads of infrastructure, AI, and engineering, as well as the commercial decision makers. Run impactful executive business reviews and leverage Cloudflare leadership at the right moments. Mobilize Cloudflare. Align the account team, Solutions Architects, FDEs, Product, and Support on the account's priorities, establishing clear owners and driving flawless follow-through. Run GTM motions in step with the workloads where we've proven fit. Close the loop with Product. Turn what you see in the account into clear, quantified recommendations on positioning, packaging, limits, and roadmap. Elevate the field: Turn your account experience into workload blueprints, deal patterns, and playbooks. Coach sales leaders and account teams in a train-the-trainer model to scale your impact globally.. Who You Are 12+ years in technology sales, including senior sales leadership (Director, VP, or CRO) or strategic named-account roles at developer-platform or consumption-based companies, such as AWS, GCP, Vercel, MongoDB, Databricks, Snowflake, or an AI lab. A track record of growing consumption and revenue in large, complex, highly technical accounts over consecutive years. Executive presence and credibility with C-level and VP audiences at the fastest-moving technology companies. The ability to turn technical workloads into compelling commercial outcomes, and to navigate complex deal approvals with Sales, Finance, Legal, and Security. Deep experience with usage-based pricing and commit structures. Analytical rigor: you can read product usage telemetry and size opportunities at the level of Sheets or SQL. A clear persuasive writer and presenter, equally effective with developer ICs and executive sponsors. A builder's mindset: you lead through influence and get cross-functional work done without relying on hierarchy. Bonus Points Experience selling to, or working inside, frontier AI labs
